401909994.summary: Every preview opened expects Boston to win and cover around 8.5-9.5. Reasons: Boston's defense against a Franz Wagner-dependent Orlando offense that is missing Paolo Banchero, plus depth and home form. The back-to-back is played down because Boston's starters were rested late in Sunday's blowout.
401909994.pick: BOS to win (all sources); Celtics -8.5/-9.5 picked by Predictem and Bettors Insider

401909994.injuries: ORL: Banchero out (ankle), Isaac out (knee), Penda out (hamstring), Nelson out (ankle). BOS: none listed.

401909998.summary: Close to a coin flip with a slight Houston lean on price: markets have the Rockets about 55-56% (FanDuel -126). Analysts split: Dimers' model takes Houston to win but Miami +2.5; Pickdawgz takes Miami +2.5 (Houston on a back-to-back, Heat 7-2 last 9). Houston is shorthanded at center and without the suspended Marcus Smart.
401909998.pick: Split: HOU slight favorite (Dimers model 56%, markets); MIA +2.5 picked by Dimers and Pickdawgz; numberFire model has MIA 56%
